name: Halifax Sourced source contract
principles: Store restaurant-owned facts and source links separately from third-party platform content.
Keep restricted platform records as source references unless the API terms permit display and retention.
Track when each captured fact was observed, where it came from, and whether it needs human review.
Never treat missing data as a negative signal; mark it as missing, stale, restricted, or unverified.

restaurant.name: Display name
restaurant.neighborhood: Halifax, Dartmouth, Bedford, or local district
restaurant.qualityScore: internal 0-100 score from weighted, source-attributed signals
restaurant.freshnessDate: YYYY-MM-DD date when facts were last checked

sources.label: Human-readable source
sources.type: restaurant_site | google_places | meta_owned_page | review_site | owner_submission | event_feed

special.title: Happy hour, daily special, tasting menu, or promo

event.title: Event name
event.sourceUrl: Official calendar, ticketing page, or restaurant-owned announcement
